Instead of retraining all 1.1 billion parameters (expensive, slow), QLoRA: 1. **Quantizes** the base model to 4-bit (8× less memory) 2. **Adds LoRA adapters** — small trainable matrices on top of frozen layers 3. Only **0.7% of parameters** are trained — 10× faster, same quality
